scope: Add shared user defaults and alternate repository config lookup to solid-coder, with repository-bounded review/search targets. Keep this separate from legacy entrypoint retirement.
lookup_policy: At each layer select the first existing candidate rather than merging aliases. Merge repository settings over shared user defaults. Alternate repo directory intentionally uses solid.coder as specified by the user.
path_constraints: Resolve review/search target paths against the selected Git repository/worktree root, including paths supplied by user-wide config.
Never resolve target paths relative to the user config directory or treat the home directory as the project root.
Validate containment after resolving symlinks; reject outside-repo absolute paths, parent traversal and symlink escapes.
Keep dependency/plugin resource paths and existing audit storage separate from review/search target containment; do not relocate them incidentally.
setup_integration: repo:setup may synchronize the project config or its repo differences; mise manages the user-wide defaults. No global setup files are changed as part of the current retirement task.
ci: Commit required CI settings in project config; CI must not depend on a developer user-wide file.
verification_to_specify: merge precedence and partial nested overrides
first-existing lookup for each alias pair
repo/worktree root selection from nested working directories
parent traversal and symlink escape rejection
legacy healthcheck and workflow review/search use identical repository boundaries
failure_policy: Selected existing unreadable, malformed, or schema-invalid config reports its source and reason; no silent alias fallback. See SPEC-071.
